name: Browser Use
tagline: Open-source browser agents and managed browser infrastructure for AI automation
description: Browser Use offers browser agents that finish web tasks and managed browsers for AI startups and automation teams. The browsers handle protected sites through an SDK, REST, or CDP. The site reports 82 percent on its internal hard benchmark at 17 cents per solved task and $0.02 per browser hour. The open-source library has about 117,000 GitHub stars.
agent_guidance: Use it when an agent must complete tasks on real websites. Respect site terms, and keep a person in the loop for purchases or account changes.
why_it_matters: It is the most starred open-source browser agent.
evidence: https://browser-use.com/ (HTTP 200, page fetched 2026-10-09), https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use (GitHub API, 117318 stars), depo.zip listing https://www.depo.zip/tools/j57e8xrry30a1y3m6j05gypsth8dasn4
tier_reason: Automation infrastructure outside interface design work.

name: Bubble Tea
tagline: Go framework for terminal user interfaces based on The Elm Architecture
description: Bubble Tea is a Go framework for building terminal apps with The Elm Architecture. It suits simple and complex interfaces, inline, full-window, or both. It runs in production in many tools and pairs with Charm's other libraries for styling and components. It uses the MIT license and has about 45,000 GitHub stars.
agent_guidance: Use it to design a command-line tool with real interface structure, such as lists, forms, and panes. Pair it with Lip Gloss for styling.
why_it_matters: It is the standard framework for well-designed terminal interfaces.
evidence: https://github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea (HTTP 200, page fetched 2026-10-09), https://github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea (GitHub API, 45350 stars), depo.zip listing https://www.depo.zip/tools/j57104yrr4hgjtwgch38pjm5ks7trqtn
tier_reason: The leading, active framework for terminal interface design.

name: Interfere
tagline: Production visibility that surfaces unseen bugs for engineers, product managers, and designers
description: Interfere gives engineers, product managers, and designers a real-time view of bugs and issues in production. The depo listing describes automatic detection and fixes in real time without people in the loop. The site has documentation.
agent_guidance: Use it to see the real errors users hit after a release. Check which session data it records.
why_it_matters: It brings production issues to the whole product team.
tier_reason: A monitoring service outside interface design work.

name: Bytescale
tagline: File storage, media processing APIs, and CDN, with an upload widget, formerly Upload.io
description: Bytescale, formerly Upload.io, is a platform for file storage, media processing, and content delivery. It offers APIs for images, video, and audio, a file upload widget, and a realtime image CDN.
agent_guidance: Use it to add uploads and image resizing without your own media pipeline. Style the upload widget to your design system.
why_it_matters: It packages upload UI, storage, and image delivery together.
tier_reason: Media infrastructure outside interface design work.

name: Capacitor
tagline: Ionic's open-source native runtime for shipping web apps to iOS, Android, and the web
description: Capacitor, by Ionic, is an open-source native runtime for web apps. You build with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and ship to iOS, Android, and progressive web apps. Plugins give access to native device features. At the time of the check, Ionic posted an announcement about the future of its commercial products.
agent_guidance: Use it to ship a web interface as a mobile app. Test platform details, such as safe areas and back gestures, on real devices.
why_it_matters: It is the main path from a web UI to the app stores.
evidence: https://capacitorjs.com/ (HTTP 200, page fetched 2026-10-09), https://github.com/ionic-team/capacitor (GitHub API, 16810 stars), depo.zip listing https://www.depo.zip/tools/j577e5eranywqkxx7a1vrwjdm17trfz1
tier_reason: A mature runtime for web-based mobile interfaces.

name: ClawControl
tagline: CLI and TUI that deploys and manages OpenClaw on a VPS with Tailscale
description: ClawControl is a command-line and terminal app that deploys and manages OpenClaw on VPS providers. It guides you through provisioning, installs dependencies, configures OpenClaw, and secures access with Tailscale. It uses the MIT license.
agent_guidance: Use it to host your own OpenClaw agent on a server. Keep the server patched, because it runs an agent with network access.
why_it_matters: It simplifies self-hosting a personal agent.
evidence: https://github.com/ipenywis/clawcontrol (HTTP 200, page fetched 2026-10-09), https://github.com/ipenywis/clawcontrol (GitHub API, 91 stars), depo.zip listing https://www.depo.zip/tools/j573d7nfjr91cx3ps9e4a9xzxd81zdav

name: Clerk
tagline: Authentication and user management with prebuilt sign-in, sign-up, and account components
description: Clerk adds authentication and user management to an app, built for React, Next.js, Remix, and other modern frameworks. It ships prebuilt components for sign-in, sign-up, and account management, plus APIs for organizations and sessions. A Clerk CLI lets coding agents set up auth from the terminal. The catalog also lists Clerk's shadcn registry separately.
agent_guidance: Use it to add complete auth screens fast. Theme the prebuilt components so sign-in matches the rest of the product.
why_it_matters: It is a common source of ready-made auth UI.
tier_reason: Design-relevant auth components, but a paid service at scale.

name: Cloudinary
tagline: Image and video upload, storage, optimization, and CDN with AI-powered asset management
description: Cloudinary manages and delivers images and video. It handles upload, storage, automatic optimization for each device, transformations, and CDN delivery. It also offers AI-powered digital asset management and low-code media workflows.
agent_guidance: Use it to serve responsive images without your own pipeline. Set transformation presets so designers get consistent crops.
why_it_matters: It is a standard media CDN for image-heavy sites.
tier_reason: Media infrastructure outside interface design work.

name: Coda
tagline: All-in-one workspace of docs, tables, apps, and AI, now part of Superhuman Docs
description: Coda blends the flexibility of docs, the structure of spreadsheets, the power of applications, and AI in one workspace. Teams build docs, hubs, trackers, and apps and consolidate other tools. At the time of the check, the site announced that Coda is now Superhuman Docs.
agent_guidance: Use it for team hubs that mix docs and trackers. Check the Superhuman Docs transition before you build on it.
why_it_matters: It is a flexible doc-and-app workspace.
tier_reason: A productivity app outside interface design work.

name: Codespace
tagline: Desktop code snippet manager with branded folders, for a one-time $12.99
description: Codespace is a desktop app for building and organizing a library of code snippets. You sort snippets into branded folders to find them fast. It costs $12.99 as a one-time purchase.
agent_guidance: Use it to keep reusable CSS and component snippets in one place. Back up the library, because it lives on one machine.
why_it_matters: It is a tidy home for reusable code.
tier_reason: A developer utility outside interface design work.

name: Commerce Layer
tagline: API-first commerce engine with universal checkout, order management, and promotions
description: Commerce Layer is an API-first commerce engine for headless stores. It includes a universal checkout, a distributed order management system, a promotion engine, a POS system, and a new payments API. It positions itself for agent-driven shopping, where AI agents find products and complete purchases.
agent_guidance: Use it when a custom-designed storefront needs a full commerce backend. Plan the checkout design yourself, because the engine is headless.
why_it_matters: It lets designers own the full storefront experience.
tier_reason: Commerce infrastructure outside interface design work.

name: ConvertAPI
tagline: API for file and document conversion in web and desktop applications
description: ConvertAPI adds file and document conversion to a website, web app, or desktop app. According to its listing, it handles many document and file formats at high performance. The automated check met a bot wall (HTTP 403), so this record uses the listing.
agent_guidance: Use it to convert documents, for example to PDF, inside an app. Confirm the formats and pricing on the site.
why_it_matters: It removes the need for local conversion tools.
tier_reason: A conversion service outside interface design work, behind a bot wall.

name: Convex
tagline: Reactive backend platform that keeps app data in sync, with auth, components, and an AI gateway
description: Convex is a reactive backend platform that keeps an app in sync in real time. It includes authentication with more than 80 OAuth integrations, an AI gateway, modular TypeScript backend components, and tooling for AI coding. The backend is open source.
agent_guidance: Use it when an interface must update live, such as a shared board. Design loading and offline states, because live data changes often.
why_it_matters: It makes real-time interfaces simple to build.
evidence: https://www.convex.dev/ (HTTP 200, page fetched 2026-10-09), https://github.com/get-convex/convex-backend (GitHub API, 12671 stars), depo.zip listing https://www.depo.zip/tools/j5767epprs6x70bh8z9hkdhq3h7t5nvs

tagline: Filesystem layer on Convex with storage, CDN delivery, and file operations
description: ConvexFS adds a filesystem on top of Convex. The docs cover storage and CDN setup, uploading and serving files, CDN parameters, filesystem operations, and an example app.
agent_guidance: Use it if your app already runs on Convex and needs file storage. Read the CDN setup step before you ship.
why_it_matters: It fills the file storage gap for Convex apps.

name: CookieFlow
tagline: Free geo-adaptive cookie consent for Webflow, ready for GDPR and CCPA
description: CookieFlow, by Reform Digital, is a free cookie consent and privacy tool for Webflow. It adapts to the visitor's region for GDPR and CCPA. You paste the component into a Webflow project and style it there.
agent_guidance: Use it on a Webflow site that needs a consent banner styled like the site. Check the legal text with counsel for your markets.
why_it_matters: It gives Webflow designers a consent banner they control.
tier_reason: A free, design-controllable consent component for Webflow.

name: CookieGuard
tagline: Cookie consent management for GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and other regulations, with a free plan
description: CookieGuard manages cookie consent across major privacy regulations, including GDPR, CCPA, and LGPD. It deploys in minutes, adapts to the visitor's region, and has transparent pricing with a free plan.
agent_guidance: Use it when you need consent management across many regions. Style the banner so it does not block the main content.
why_it_matters: It handles consent rules across regions.
tier_reason: A compliance service outside interface design work.

name: Coolify
tagline: Open-source, self-hostable alternative to Heroku, Netlify, and Vercel with 280+ services
description: Coolify is an open-source, self-hostable platform for deploying apps, databases, and more than 280 one-click services to your own servers. It is free forever when self-hosted, with a paid cloud option. It uses the Apache 2.0 license and has about 63,000 GitHub stars.
agent_guidance: Use it to host many small sites and services on your own server. Plan backups and updates, because you run the platform.
why_it_matters: It is the leading open-source self-hosting platform.
evidence: https://coolify.io/ (HTTP 200, page fetched 2026-10-09), https://github.com/coollabsio/coolify (GitHub API, 62733 stars), depo.zip listing https://www.depo.zip/tools/j576vqk90x6qgathykw0zf0qh97t491y

name: Formspree
tagline: Form backend and API for HTML and JavaScript forms, with a library of example forms
description: Formspree is a form backend, API, and email service for HTML and JavaScript forms. You embed custom forms on a static website without server code. A library of example HTML forms with editable code, and guides for major website platforms, help you start.
agent_guidance: Use it for contact and signup forms on static sites. Design the error and success states yourself.
why_it_matters: It lets a designed static site collect form data without a backend.
tier_reason: A simple, design-friendly form backend with copyable examples.

name: deepsec
tagline: Vercel tool that uses coding agents to find and revalidate vulnerabilities across a repository
description: deepsec uses coding agents to find vulnerabilities across an entire repository. It revalidates every finding before it reaches your team, to reduce false positives. A CLI command sets it up, and OpenSec uses it for donated open-source reviews.
agent_guidance: Use it to review a codebase for security issues before launch. Confirm each finding, even after revalidation.
why_it_matters: It applies coding agents to security review.
tier_reason: A security tool outside interface design work.

name: DigitalOcean
tagline: Cloud platform for startups with compute, databases, containers, and AI inference
description: DigitalOcean is a cloud platform built for startups and small to mid-size businesses. It covers compute, containers, managed databases, storage, and now a stack for AI agents and inference.
agent_guidance: Use it for simple, predictable hosting. It has no role in interface design work.
why_it_matters: It is a common, simple cloud for small teams.
tier_reason: Cloud infrastructure outside interface design work.

name: Directus
tagline: Self-hostable headless CMS and backend over any SQL database, with REST, GraphQL, and MCP
description: Directus is a collaborative backend and self-hostable headless CMS that runs over any SQL database. It gives a no-code interface for content, REST and GraphQL APIs, and MCP access for Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor.
agent_guidance: Use it to give editors a clean admin over an existing database. Customize the admin views for each editor role.
why_it_matters: It turns any database into an editable content backend.

It covers draggable and droppable elements, sortable lists, and extensions, with keyboard and screen reader support. It uses the MIT license and has about 17,700 GitHub stars.
agent_guidance: Use it for sortable lists, boards, and reorderable layouts. Test keyboard dragging, and give screen reader announcements for each move.
why_it_matters: It is the standard headless toolkit for accessible drag and drop.

why_it_matters: It is a popular open-source deployment dashboard.

description: Doppler centralizes secrets management for people and AI agents. It secures, syncs, and automates secrets across environments, with developer workflows and an MCP server for agents.

why_it_matters: It addresses secret sprawl as agents multiply.

agent_guidance: Use it for complex app logic where errors must be explicit. Budget learning time, because the style differs from plain TypeScript.
why_it_matters: It is a leading library for reliable TypeScript programs.

name: Encore
tagline: Backend development platform for distributed systems with local dev tools and cloud automation
description: Encore is a development platform for event-driven and distributed backend systems. It provides local development tools and DevOps automation for AWS and GCP. The automated check failed, but a manual request on 2026-10-09 returned HTTP 200.
agent_guidance: Use it to build backends with infrastructure defined in code. It has no role in interface design work.
why_it_matters: It shortens backend setup for small teams.

name: Fathom Analytics
tagline: Privacy-first, GDPR-compliant website analytics as a Google Analytics alternative
description: Fathom Analytics is privacy-focused website analytics from a sustainable company. It replaces Google Analytics with a simple dashboard, email reports, EU data isolation, and full legal compliance, without spying on visitors.
agent_guidance: Use it to measure a marketing site without a cookie banner for analytics. Check that its event tracking covers your conversion goals.
why_it_matters: It is a common privacy-first analytics choice.
tier_reason: An analytics service outside interface design work.

name: Favicon.io
tagline: Free favicon generator that makes favicon.ico and app icons from text, an image, or emoji
description: Favicon.io is a free favicon generator. It creates a favicon.ico and app icons from text, an image, an SVG, or hundreds of emoji, and you download all icon files in one ZIP. It also has a converter and tutorials.
agent_guidance: Use it for a quick favicon set on a new site. Check the icon at 16 pixels, where detail disappears.
why_it_matters: It is the quickest way to get a complete favicon set.
tier_reason: A simple, free tool that designers use often.

name: Felt
tagline: AI-native GIS for collaborative maps of sites, assets, and field operations in the browser
description: Felt is a collaborative mapping and GIS tool in the browser. Teams put sites, assets, and field operations on one live map, connect data, ask questions in plain language, and run GIS analysis. It started as a simple way to make and share maps.
agent_guidance: Use it to make a clear, shareable map for a project or report. Its map styling makes it a reference for map interface design.
why_it_matters: It is a well-designed modern map tool.
tier_reason: A mapping app outside interface design work.

name: Files SDK

description: Files SDK, by Hayden Bleasel, is a unified SDK for S3, R2, Google Cloud Storage, Azure, and more than 40 object and blob stores. It offers one small API with web-standard I/O and a typed escape hatch to the native client. It installs from npm.
agent_guidance: Use it to avoid lock-in to one storage provider. Test large uploads with each backend you plan to use.
why_it_matters: It removes storage vendor lock-in from app code.
